header.userPrompt:
Extract a shared helper for mui.Autocomplete to remove the repeated js.Dynamic prop-setting block across the web frontend. Implements issue #120. Pure refactor, no behaviour change.

## Problem
Every `mui.Autocomplete` call site repeats the same ~18-line construction: build `AutocompleteProps[...]`, cast to `js.Dynamic`, and assign `freeSolo` / `size` / `fullWidth` / `inputValue` / `getOptionLabel` / `onChange` / `onInputChange`. The ScalablyTyped fluent builder does not expose those props, so this cast-and-mutate dance (documented as RULE-FE-012 in `docs/guide/frontend.md`) is unavoidable per site, but it is duplicated, verbose, and easy to get subtly wrong.

The block currently appears, 2 to 3 times each, in these files under `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/`:
- `components/pages/bankstatementreview/BankRowRuleForm.scala`
- `components/pages/bankstatementreview/BankRowCreateExpenseForm.scala`
- `components/pages/bankstatementreview/BankRowCreateRefundForm.scala`
- `components/pages/receipts/ReceiptsPage.scala`
- `components/pages/importrules/ImportRulesPage.scala`
- `components/pages/expenses/BulkExpenseCreationPage.scala`
- `components/pages/merchants/BulkMerchantSetupPage.scala`
- `components/pages/merchants/MerchantReviewPage.scala`

The merchant/category type-aheads are the common shape: a free-solo, single-select Autocomplete over a labeled list, controlled by `inputValue`, with an `onSelect` and an `onInput`.

Start by reading `BankRowRuleForm.scala` (the canonical copy of the block) and `MuiCompat.scala` plus `AutocompleteLabels` to see the existing shared helpers, then inspect every call site above to catalog the real variations before designing the helper.

## Proposal
Add a small helper (e.g. in `MuiCompat`, alongside the existing compat helpers) that builds a configured `AutocompleteProps` for the common free-solo single-select case from a few parameters: options, label, `inputValue`, `getOptionLabel`, `onSelect`, `onInput`. This collapses each block to one call and keeps the `js.Dynamic` mutation in exactly one place. Then convert the call sites to use it.

## Constraints (must follow)
- Reads of the selected value in callbacks must stay on the `(value: Any) match { case x: T => ... }` pattern (and the shared `AutocompleteLabels`); reading Scala case-class fields off `js.Dynamic` returns undefined because the fields are name-mangled. The helper must only centralise prop-SETTING, not field reads. Do NOT move the `(value: Any) match` reads into the helper.
- Pure refactor, no behaviour change. Keep per-site specifics (e.g. the create-expense merchant selection cascading its default category) at the call site via the `onSelect` callback.
- If a call site has a genuinely different shape (not free-solo, not single-select, or extra props the helper does not cover), leave it as-is rather than forcing it through the helper or widening the helper with speculative parameters. Only convert the sites that match the common shape. Note in the PR body which sites, if any, were left unconverted and why.
- Custom wart `NamedArguments`: when a call passes 2 or more arguments of the same type, they MUST be passed by name or compilation fails. Design the helper's signature and update call sites accordingly.
- Match existing style. Do not reformat or "improve" adjacent code. Every changed line must trace to this refactor.
- Update `docs/guide/frontend.md` RULE-FE-012 so it points at the new helper as the one place the cast-and-mutate lives, instead of describing it as per-site boilerplate. Do not renumber other rules.

## Conventions
- Follow `docs/guide/` (architecture.md, frontend.md, testing.md, antipatterns.md, ci-checklist.md).
- Public repository: no PII anywhere in code, comments, or the PR text. The PR description must NOT contain any claude.ai session link.

## Verification / acceptance criteria
- `web/compile` succeeds (Scala.js), the frontend still builds, and `CI=true sbt Test/compile` is clean.
- Existing web tests still pass unchanged (this is a pure refactor); run the web test suite. Do not weaken or delete tests to make them pass.
- Each converted call site behaves identically: same options, same label, same `inputValue` control, same selection cascade and input handling as before.
- The ~18-line js.Dynamic block no longer appears duplicated across the converted sites; it lives in the single helper.
- No behaviour change anywhere in the app.

resultJson.description:
Issue #120: every free-solo merchant/category `mui.Autocomplete` in the web frontend repeats the same ~18-line block. It builds `AutocompleteProps[T, Boolean, Boolean, Boolean, "div"]`, casts it to `js.Dynamic`, and sets `freeSolo`, `size`, `inputValue`, `getOptionLabel`, `onChange` and `onInputChange` (some sites also set `disabled` or `fullWidth`). This epic adds one helper, `MuiCompat.freeSoloAutocompleteProps`, in the compat layer and becomes the only place that cast-and-mutate lives. The common-shape call sites are then converted to a single call each. It is a pure refactor with no behaviour change.

The helper only centralises prop setting. Each call site still reads the selected value with `(value: Any) match { case x: T => ... }`, keeps using `AutocompleteLabels` for `getOptionLabel`, and keeps its own cascade logic. One example is the merchant pick that fills in its default category. The helper passes the raw onChange value to `onSelect` and the decoded `(text, reason)` from `MuiCompat.autocompleteInputChange` to `onInput`, so each site keeps its exact `reason != "reset"` handling. Each site also keeps its own `renderInput` function, so label, size and TextField key don't change.

Sites that don't fit the shape stay as they are and are listed in the PR body:
- **`BulkMerchantSetupPage`**: also sets `sx` (minWidth), which only that file needs.
- **`MerchantReviewPage`**: the duplicate picker is not free-solo. It is controlled by `value`, has `isOptionEqualToValue`, and uses its own `getOptionLabel`.

`docs/guide/frontend.md` RULE-FE-012 and the RULE-FE-014 helper table are updated to point at the new helper.

tasks.title: Add MuiCompat.freeSoloAutocompleteProps helper with unit tests and doc update
Convert bank-statement-review forms to the helper
tasks.description:
Replace the 6 Autocomplete blocks in these files under `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages/bankstatementreview/` with `MuiCompat.freeSoloAutocompleteProps(...)`. Keep the existing val names (`acProps`/`catAcProps`, `merchantAcProps`/`categoryAcProps`) so the `mui.Autocomplete.withProps(x).withKey(...)` render lines stay unchanged.

- **`BankRowRuleForm.scala`** (lines ~164-204): both blocks pass `disabled = saving`.
  - Merchant: onSelect → `setMerchantIdOpt(Some(m.id)); setMerchantInput(m.name)`.
  - Category: onSelect → `setCategoryIdOpt(Some(c.id)); setCategoryInput(c.name)`.
- **`BankRowCreateExpenseForm.scala`** (lines ~385-425): both blocks pass `fullWidth = true`.
  - Merchant: onSelect → `selectMerchant(m)`. This is the cascade; leave it untouched.
  - Category: as above.
- **`BankRowCreateRefundForm.scala`** (lines ~157-197): both blocks pass `fullWidth = true`.
  - Merchant: onSelect → `selectMerchant(m)`.
  - Category: as above.

Call shape, all args named:
```scala
MuiCompat.freeSoloAutocompleteProps(
  options = props.merchants,
  renderInput = renderTextField("Merchant"),
  inputValue = merchantInput,
  getOptionLabel = AutocompleteLabels.merchantOptionLabel,
  onSelect = value => (value: Any) match { case m: GetMerchants.Response.Merchant => ...; case _ => () },
  onInput = (text, rsn) => { setMerchantInput(text); if (rsn != "reset") setMerchantIdOpt(None) },
  disabled = saving
)
```

Keep the per-site label strings exactly, e.g. "Merchant (optional)" and "Category (optional)" in the refund form. Then remove only the imports this change orphaned: `AutocompleteProps`, `scala.scalajs.js`, and `JSConverters.*` if `toJSArray` is no longer used in that file. Check every file before removing anything.

Verify with `CI=true sbt Test/compile`, then run the existing specs for these forms under `web/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages/bankstatementreview/`. Glob for them first, e.g. `sbt "web/testOnly *BankRow*Spec *BankStatementReview*Spec"`. They must pass without changes.

tasks.description:
Replace the remaining common-shape blocks with `MuiCompat.freeSoloAutocompleteProps(...)`, passing all args by name.

- **`components/pages/receipts/ReceiptsPage.scala`**:
  - `merchantAutocomplete` (~577-598): options `props.merchants.data`; onSelect → `updateForm(_.copy(merchantId = m.id.toString, merchantInput = m.name))`; onInput → `(text, rsn) => updateForm(f => f.copy(merchantInput = text, merchantId = if (rsn != "reset") "" else f.merchantId))`.
  - `splitRow` category (~614-637): options `props.categories.data`; inputValue `catInput`. In onInput, the `setSplits` update runs only when `rsn != "reset"`, and the input text is NOT updated on reset. Keep that exactly.
  - No disabled or fullWidth.
- **`components/pages/importrules/ImportRulesPage.scala`**:
  - `merchantAutocomplete` and `categoryAutocomplete` (~317-369): options `localMerchants` / `localCategories`; renderInput `renderMerchantTextField` / `renderCategoryTextField`; onSelect → `onIdChange(Some(x.id)); onInputChange(x.name)`; onInput → `onInputChange(text); if (rsn != "reset") onIdChange(None)`.
  - The local params named `inputValue` and `onInputChange` shadow nothing in the helper call, but write `inputValue = inputValue` explicitly.
- **`components/pages/expenses/BulkExpenseCreationPage.scala`** (~255-301): both pass `disabled = saving`.
  - The merchant onSelect keeps the full category cascade (`m.categoryId.foreach { cid => setCategoryIdOpt(Some(cid)); categories.find(_.id == cid).foreach(c => setCategoryInput(c.name)) }`).

Do NOT convert these, and leave them byte-identical:
- **`merchants/BulkMerchantSetupPage.scala`**: it also sets `sx` minWidth, and its category onSelect doesn't set input.
- **`merchants/MerchantReviewPage.scala`**: it is not freeSolo, is value-controlled, uses `isOptionEqualToValue` and has a custom `getOptionLabel`.

Remove only the imports this change orphaned, checking each file for other uses of `js` and `toJSArray`.

Verify with `CI=true sbt Test/compile`, then run the existing specs for these pages, e.g. `sbt "web/testOnly *ReceiptsPage*Spec *ImportRules*Spec *BulkExpenseCreation*Spec"` (glob `web/src/test` for the real names). They must pass unchanged.

The PR body must:
- list the two unconverted sites and why;
- contain no PII and no claude.ai links.

resultJson.brief:
Modules
- `web/` holds the Scala.js + Slinky + MUI 5 frontend, using ScalablyTyped `com.olvind.mui` facades. The compat layer is `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/webapp/utils/slinkyUtils/compat/`. Under RULE-FE-014 it is the only approved place for `js.Dynamic` and `asInstanceOf`.
- Pages are in `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages/`.

Key existing APIs
- `MuiCompat.scala`, package `net.wiringbits.webapp.utils.slinkyUtils.compat`:
  - `paginationProps(count, page, onChange, size: Option[String] = None)` sets size only if provided; its spec checks that the field is undefined otherwise.
  - `textFieldProps(params: AutocompleteRenderInputParams, label: String, size: Option[String] = None): OutlinedTextFieldProps`
  - `autocompleteInputChange(value: js.Any, reason: js.Any): (String, String)` returns "" for non-strings.
  - `tabValue(v: Any): String`
  - Current imports: `AutocompleteRenderInputParams`, `PaginationProps`, `OutlinedTextFieldProps`, `scala.scalajs.js`.
- `components/pages/AutocompleteLabels.scala` has `private[pages] def merchantOptionLabel(opt: js.Any): String` and `private[pages] def categoryOptionLabel(opt: js.Any): String`. Both use `(opt: Any) match`. Call sites in `pages` can pass them as `getOptionLabel = AutocompleteLabels.merchantOptionLabel` (eta-expansion). They are private[pages], so the helper must take getOptionLabel as a parameter, never import them.
- `AutocompleteProps` is in `com.olvind.mui.muiMaterial.autocompleteAutocompleteMod.{AutocompleteProps, AutocompleteRenderInputParams}`. Its type params must be `[T, Boolean, Boolean, Boolean, "div"]`, with a literal "div".
- Rendering: `(mui.Autocomplete.withProps(props).withKey("k"): ReactElement)`, with `import com.olvind.mui.muiMaterial.components as mui`. `withProps` returns a Builder, not an element, so `.withKey` is required. The render lines at call sites should not change.

Canonical block being replaced (`BankRowRuleForm.scala:164-183`):
```scala
val acProps = AutocompleteProps[GetMerchants.Response.Merchant, Boolean, Boolean, Boolean, "div"](options = props.merchants.toJSArray, renderInput = renderTextField("Merchant"))
val acDyn = acProps.asInstanceOf[js.Dynamic]
acDyn.freeSolo = true; acDyn.size = "small"; acDyn.disabled = saving; acDyn.inputValue = merchantInput
acDyn.getOptionLabel = (opt: js.Any) => AutocompleteLabels.merchantOptionLabel(opt)
acDyn.onChange = (_: js.Any, value: js.Any, _: js.Any, _: js.Any) => (value: Any) match { case m: GetMerchants.Response.Merchant => setMerchantIdOpt(Some(m.id)); setMerchantInput(m.name); case _ => () }
acDyn.onInputChange = (_: js.Any, value: js.Any, reason: js.Any) => { val (text, rsn) = MuiCompat.autocompleteInputChange(value = value, reason = reason); setMerchantInput(text); if (rsn != "reset") setMerchantIdOpt(None) }
```

Variation catalogue (verified)
- Every block sets freeSolo=true and size="small".
- `disabled = saving`: BankRowRuleForm, BulkExpenseCreationPage, BulkMerchantSetupPage.
- `fullWidth = true`: BankRowCreateExpenseForm, BankRowCreateRefundForm.
- `sx` (minWidth): only BulkMerchantSetupPage, so it is NOT converted.
- MerchantReviewPage (~390-411) is a different shape and is NOT converted: no freeSolo, `value` and `isOptionEqualToValue` set, `getOptionLabel` reads `js.Dynamic.name`. That last part is a pre-existing smell; mention it, don't fix it.
- ReceiptsPage split-row onInput only acts when `rsn != "reset"`. ReceiptsPage merchant onInput is one `updateForm` call. Because the helper passes `(text, reason)` to `onInput`, every site keeps its exact logic.
- Each file has its own `renderTextField`, with different `.withKey("tf")` and size choices. Keep passing the site's own function as `renderInput` and leave those defs untouched.
- The merchant cascade into the default category lives in `selectMerchant(m)` (CreateExpense/Refund forms) or inline (BulkExpenseCreationPage). It must stay at the call site inside `onSelect`.

Constraints and conventions
- Keep `(value: Any) match { case x: T => ...; case _ => () }` at the call site. onSelect takes `js.Any` precisely so this ascription stays meaningful. Never read case-class fields off `js.Dynamic`: Scala.js mangles the names, so they come back undefined.
- Wartremover `NamedArguments` (custom wart) fails compilation when 2+ same-typed args are positional. Pass every helper argument by name, matching existing `autocompleteInputChange(value = ..., reason = ...)` usage.
- Surgical edits only. Don't reformat adjacent code, and remove only the imports your change orphans (`AutocompleteProps`, `scala.scalajs.js`, `JSConverters.*`). Check other uses in the file first; e.g. BankRowRuleForm has no other `js`/`toJSArray` usage after conversion, but verify each file.
- Tests are ScalaTest `AnyWordSpec` with `org.scalatest.matchers.must.Matchers.*`. The compat spec reads props via `props.asInstanceOf[js.Dynamic].field` (allowed in tests). Under RULE-FE-015, render tests for MUI wrappers are not required.
- Build: typecheck with `CI=true sbt Test/compile`; run targeted tests with `sbt "web/testOnly *XSpec"`. Do not run the full `sbt test`. Web tests need Node 24 on PATH (default node v16 breaks yarn install). Run `sbt scalafmtAll scalafmtSbt` before committing.
- Public repo: no PII anywhere, and no claude.ai session links in the PR text.
- Docs: `docs/guide/frontend.md` RULE-FE-012 is at ~lines 260-330, and the RULE-FE-014 helper table at ~380-388. Do not renumber rules.

resultJson.title: Extract MuiCompat.freeSoloAutocompleteProps for free-solo Autocomplete call sites
resultJson.body:
Implements #120. This is a pure refactor and should not change behaviour.

Many `mui.Autocomplete` call sites repeated the same block: build `AutocompleteProps`, cast it to `js.Dynamic`, then set `freeSolo`, `size`, `inputValue`, `getOptionLabel`, `onChange` and `onInputChange`. That block now lives in one new helper, `MuiCompat.freeSoloAutocompleteProps`. These pages now call the helper:
- the three bank-statement-review forms
- `ReceiptsPage`
- `ImportRulesPage`
- `BulkExpenseCreationPage`

The helper only sets props. Each call site still reads the selected value itself with `(value: Any) match` and keeps its own logic, such as a merchant pick filling in its default category. `onSelect` gets the raw selected value. `onInput` gets the decoded `(text, reason)`, so each site keeps its own handling of `reason != "reset"`. All arguments are passed by name.

For reviewers:
- The helper sets `disabled` and `fullWidth` only when they are true and leaves them undefined otherwise. Before, `BankRowRuleForm` and `BulkExpenseCreationPage` always assigned `disabled = saving`, even when `saving` was false. MUI treats undefined and false the same way.
- Two sites still build their props by hand:
  - **`BulkMerchantSetupPage`** also sets `sx` (minWidth), which the helper doesn't cover.
  - **`MerchantReviewPage`** has a different shape: it is not free-solo, it is controlled by `value`, and it uses `isOptionEqualToValue` and its own `getOptionLabel`.

`MuiCompatSpec` has new unit tests for the helper. In `docs/guide/frontend.md`, RULE-FE-012 now points to the helper instead of showing the cast-and-mutate code at each site, and the RULE-FE-014 helper table has a new row for it.

Closes #120
